title: Sri Lanka Highlights | Getaway to the Pearl of Indian Ocean
highlights: Experience the culture of Kandy with a visit to the sacred Temple of the Tooth Relic, followed by traditional Kandyan Dance.
Visit Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery, where you can look at the baby turtles up close in their natural surroundings.
Dive into thrilling water sports at Bentota Beach and enjoy the boat ride along the scenic Madu River.
Explore Colombo on a guided tour, with iconic landmarks like the Lotus Tower and the Pettah Floating Market.
overview:
About the Tour:
Endowed with a diverse collection of landscapes, climates, natural features and infamous beaches Sri Lanka has been enticing visitors for many years. Offering a myriad range of fun, adventure, and romance, it is among the best destinations in the world for those looking for an exotic vacation with a luxrious stay. Enjoy every minute of it. Be it the ocean, the forest or even the city, you’ll be able to soak it all in, what makes the soul-satisfying everything make it a paradise that bedazzles everyone!
Begin your amazing tour by visiting the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage and watching the naughty elephants, yet adorable creatures bathe in the river near the orphanage where they engage in mischief, pull each other by their tails, and try to escape the hands of their caretakers in amusing ways. Awaken the adventurous soul in you by indulging in a myriad of water sports for fun and thrill in Bentota from jet skiing, banana boat ride, parasailing, paramotoring, speed boat ride, yachting, canoeing, kayaking, to boating in the mangrove forests. Conclude this tour by visiting the Red Mosque, a stunning candy-like red and white striped mosque named ‘Jami Ul-Alfar’ is the most spectacular building in your entire trip in Colombo.

Duration: 5 Days 4 Nights

End Point: Bandaranaike International Airport (Colombo)

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | Transfer to Kandy
days.desc: Board your pre-booked transfers from the airport to Kandy. En route, visit the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage. Upon arrival, check-in and get ready to enjoy the Upper Lake drive and Kandyan Dance performance. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage Visit on a Private basis
Lake Drive with Kandyan Dance Show on a Private basis

days.title: Arrival in Bentota | Visit Turtle Hatchery
days.desc: Check-out form the hotel and board your transfer to Bentota. En route, view huge tea plantations and visit Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery to involve yourself with baby turtles. Upon arrival, check-in and relax for an overnight stay.

items.title: Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery Visit on a Private basis

days.title: Water Sports at Bentota | Madu River
days.desc: Get transferred from the hotel for a scenic boat ride to the Madu river. Next, visit Bentota beach to enjoy various water sports activities. Later, visit Cinnamon plantations and get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Boat Ride at Madu River on a Private basis

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | Colombo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Check-out and take your pre-booked transfers to Colombo. Upon arrival, check-in and get ready for the Colombo sightseeing tour. Visit attractions like Lotus Tower, Pettah Floating Market, Gangaramaya Buddhist temple, and more. Later, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Full Day Colombo Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: After breakfast, check-out and get transferred to the airport. This is where your trip ends.
